actions.action: docker compose exec -T -u node node pnpm exec commitlint --edit /app/.git/COMMIT_EDITMSG
actions.description: Validate commit message format against Conventional Commits standard

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | xargs -r -I {} sh -c 'case "{}" in *.sh) [ "$(stat -c %a "{}")" != "755" ] && chmod 755 "{}" && git add "{}" && echo "Fixed: {} -> 755" ;; *.md|*.json|*.js|*.cjs|*.ts|*.yaml|*.yml|*.php|*.neon|*.xml|.prettier*|.npm*|.markdown*) [ "$(stat -c %a "{}")" = "600" ] || [ "$(stat -c %a "{}")" = "660" ] && chmod 644 "{}" && git add "{}" && echo "Fixed: {} -> 644" ;; esac' || true
actions.description: Fix file permissions on staged files (scripts: 755, configs: 644)

actions.action: docker compose exec -T -u node node pnpm exec lint-staged --no-stash
actions.description: Fix code style on staged Node.js files (TS/JS, JSON, MD) via Prettier, ESLint, Markdownlint (auto-fix and re-stage). Uses --no-stash to avoid git stash issues with bind-mounted files in Docker.

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | grep '.php$' | grep -v '^docker/' | grep -v '^\.php-cs-fixer' | grep -v '^rector\.php$' | xargs -r -I {} docker compose exec -T php php -l /var/www/html/{}
actions.description: Check PHP syntax on staged files (excludes root config files)

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | grep '.php$' | grep -v '^docker/' | grep -v '^\.php-cs-fixer' | grep -v '^rector\.php$' | xargs -r sh -c 'docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php $(echo "$@" | sed "s|[^ ]*|/var/www/html/&|g") && git add $@' _
actions.description: Fix PHP coding style on staged files (excludes root config files)

actions.action: docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration=phpstan.neon --memory-limit=1G
actions.description: Run PHPStan static analysis (Level 5) before pushing to remote
Run PHPUnit tests (PHP unit & integration tests)

actions.action: docker compose exec -T -u node node pnpm run type-check
docker compose exec -T -u node node pnpm test
actions.description: Run Vitest tests (Node.js unit & integration tests)
